description: I blew 3 funded accounts before I understood what smart money was actually doing. One shift in how I read order blocks changed everything. This is the R2F Trading system — and it works. Follow for daily ICT setups. r2ftrading.com
script: I blew 3 funded accounts in 6 months. Same setup. Same mistake. Every single time. I was chasing price. Entering late. Getting stopped out right before the move. Then the R2F Trading system showed me something. Smart money doesn't chase. It waits at order blocks. Every loss had one thing in common. I was buying INTO the order block. Not waiting for the retest. One rule change. Wait for the fair value gap fill INSIDE the order block. Then enter. Next funded challenge — passed in 11 days. Same market. Different eyes. The market didn't change. The approach did. Follow R2F Trading. Daily ICT setups — link in bio at r2ftrading.com.
